messages.author: df2ff87426a98fc9
messages.subject: Guidelines for Avoiding Over-parameterized Models
parts:
I have found conflicting information when it comes to limiting the
number of estimable parameters in occupancy models (single species,
single season for example). One suggestion is to keep the maximum
number of model parameters under the number of unique encounter
histories and the other suggests ensuring that you have 10x the number
of sites to parameters. What IS the rule of thumb in this situation?

Cheers,
Dan

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Guidelines for Avoiding Over-parameterized Models
parts:
hi Dan,
 There are no reasonable rules of thumb in my view.  Given that replicates provide direct information about p and sites provide direct information about psi, then you need replicates or sites or both depending on where your parameters are. 
regards,
andy
